g.title: BoundaryProgramme
g.text: Boundary Cognition Research Programme | Global map
Research motivation ≠ theorem dependency; formal results ≠ empirical conclusions

g.title: cluster_tracks
g.text: Four interconnected research lines that must not be conflated into a single theorem chain

g.title: cluster_extensions
g.text: External interpretation / follow-up work

g.title: origin
g.text: Research starting point | programmatic premise (not a Lean theorem)
Core of self-consciousness: identify, represent and maintain the 'self / non-self' boundary

g.title: framing
g.text: Formalisation branches
Different model lines unfold from a shared research motivation; not every theorem follows directly from the starting point.

g.title: origin->framing
g.text: Research motivation / operationalisation

g.title: A
g.text: A | Boundary potential (value layer)
Attribution field: pS(x)=s(κ(x−μ))
H(κ)=C_H/κ, C_H=π²/3
σ(κ)=σ₀κ²
V(κ)=c₀κ+αC_H/κ
σ*=π²α/(3C₀)
Status: core mathematical results formalised;
physical variable mappings remain model assumptions

g.title: B
g.text: B | Boundary–self-report (conditional identity)
R : Set(Set Ω), C=clos(I)
repClosed(R,S)=⋂{T∈R : S⊆T}
When R is upward-closed: the report family and the closure operator
determine each other uniquely
Status: the conditional theorem is formalised;
counterexamples exist once the premise is dropped

g.title: C
g.text: C | Level self-reference (a specified selector)
Specify R(w)=1/w
Under this map the self-consistent solution is unique
Counterexample: P(w):=(w=2) also selects uniquely
a different level
Status: this particular proposal holds;
'unique among all selectors' does not hold

g.title: D
g.text: D | Assembly at the closure face
Given c′≤c: a polarity-change witness
⇔ Fix(c) ⊂ Fix(c′)
the closure/adjunction structure of commit is formalised
Open item: construct c′ from σ_mech>σ*, and
prove that the assembly event exists
Status: the criterion is proved;
positive existence is not proved

g.title: EA
g.text: Evidence A | Lean proof of the exact integral + numerical cross-check
does not by itself show that real minds or physical systems satisfy the mapping

g.title: EB
g.text: Evidence B | Lean conditional identity + counterexamples
Level 2 toy machine: 6 pre-registered pass / 1 fail

g.title: EC
g.text: Evidence C | Lean results for the specified self-consistency equation
other selection mechanisms are not excluded by this theorem

g.title: ED
g.text: Evidence D | Assembly criterion and operational structure
positive generation in real systems remains to be proved / tested

g.title: interp
g.text: Interpretation and application layer | philosophical interpretations or engineering/empirical directions, not conclusions automatically derived from the mathematical theorems

g.title: K
g.text: Kant companion paper
an aspectual reading of Grenze / Schranke
philosophical interpretation, not a Lean conclusion

g.title: interp->K
g.text: Interpretation

g.title: R
g.text: Engineering direction
joint boundary–self-report state and atomic commit
currently an architectural proposal / toy-machine evidence

g.title: interp->R
g.text: Engineering

g.title: X
g.text: Empirical direction
neuroscience κ↔β, robotics variable mappings
testable hypotheses; not yet empirical conclusions

g.title: interp->X
g.text: to be tested

g.title: foot
g.text: Legend: solid = evidence chain of the corresponding research line; dashed = research motivation / conceptual link; dotted = interpretation or application direction.
Counts for the unified repository and the archival status of the Level 2 machine follow each fixed version and its release record.
